Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q2 2021 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of PG.
We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $1.11 per share.
While we remain optimistic, there can be no assurance that macroeconomic headwinds won't affect demand.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q2 2021.
Our cloud segment grew 23% year-over-year, driven by strong enterprise demand.
Revenue guidance of $7.3 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
What assumptions underpin your free cash flow guidance given the elevated capex spend?
Thank you for the question. Our gross margin expanded by 178 basis points to 52.7%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
Second question - Analyst:
What assumptions underpin your free cash flow guidance given the elevated capex spend?
Our outlook assumes current foreign exchange rates hold; currency fluctuations could materially affect results.
